meaning:
ἀ-διά-κριτος, -ον
(διακρίνω), [in LXX: Pro.25:1 * ;]
1. not to be parted, mixed, undistinguishable (cf. Pr, l.with, and see Lft., Ignat. Eph., §3).
2. without uncertainty (Hort, in l., but see MM, VGT, see word): Jas.3:17.
† (AS)

elsewhere.note: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceful, gentle, reasonable, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.
